quote: In this work, we take a close look at the current practice of minimizing reconstruction errors for pruning LLMs.
outputs: The paper focuses on pruning large language models and generating calibration data using self-generation from the model, which involves natural language generation as part of the calibration process.

quote: Specifically, we measure the perplexity of the pruned model on three different datasets: raw-Wikitext2, PTB, and validation data of C4. We also measure its zero-shot task performance in accuracy on seven downstream tasks...

We measure the perplexity of the pruned model on three different datasets: raw-Wikitext2, PTB, and validation data of C4. We also measure its zero-shot task performance in accuracy on seven downstream tasks: BoolQ, RTE, HellaSwag, Winogrande, ARC Easy and Challenge, and OpenbookQA.
